facts.name: card_site_codes
facts.note: valid loop-number codes of one site (the flux cap: virtual spin at most 1)

facts.name: card_inner_codes
facts.note: inner codes: four valid sites obeying the Abelian Gauss law on the four inner links

facts.name: card_bright_codes
facts.note: inner codes on which the plaquette coupling is non-zero

facts.name: card_dark_codes
facts.note: inner codes on which the plaquette coupling is zero

facts.name: card_states_lsh
facts.note: physical states = valid data codes with a valid outer-site pattern

facts.name: card_bright_states
facts.note: physical states whose inner code is bright

facts.name: site_valid_list
facts.note: the five valid site codes (bit 0 = l_pn, bit 1 = l_nv, bit 2 = l_vp)

facts.name: inner_codes_from_rules
facts.note: the 47 inner codes are exactly the codes cut out by the flux cap and the Abelian Gauss law

facts.name: coupling_zero_iff_dark
facts.note: the coupling is zero exactly on dark codes

facts.name: dark_site_is_and
facts.note: a site is dark iff l_nv AND l_vp are both set (one AND of raw bits)

facts.name: coupling_by_y_weight
facts.note: on bright codes 2K depends only on the number of set l_nv bits: {number of set l_nv bits: 2K}

facts.name: link_bit_two_ways
facts.note: every inner link bit is readable at two sites: l_pn xor l_nv at one site = l_pn xor l_vp at the next

facts.name: move_per_site
facts.note: the plaquette move flips l_pn where w = l_nv xor l_vp is 0 and l_nv, l_vp where w is 1; value: the site XOR pattern {w=0, w=1}

facts.name: y_parity_invariant
facts.note: the parity of the four l_nv bits is unchanged by the move and equals [2K = +2]

facts.name: eight_differences
facts.note: the eight difference vectors (code XOR partner) of the move are pairwise different: no CNOT-only frame exists

facts.name: transcode_into_spinnet
facts.note: the per-site transcoder maps the 47 LSH inner codes onto valid spin-network codes

facts.name: coupling_matches_spinnet
facts.note: the LSH coupling table equals the spin-network coupling on the transcoded codes

facts.name: n_outer_site_patterns
facts.note: distinct outer-site patterns (the 12 read-only outer qubits take 305 values on the physical states); measured, not proved

facts.name: transcoder_overhead
facts.note: CX and fixed T of the per-site transcoder and its inverse around a spin-network circuit; measured on the circuit

provenance.values_from: Lean theorem statements, cross-checked against the Python encoding; two facts are numerical
provenance.trust: kernel-checked (by decide, standard axioms only) except the facts marked numerical
